reviews.text: David Taylor and the whole work crew with IFC did an amazing job on our new roof! We're first-time roof buyers, so there was a lot of apprehension. David made this a seamless experience from start to finish, taking care of every detail with thoughtful integrity. We highly recommend IFC, David, and their stone-coated steel roof!

IFC Roofing is an articulate roofing company and work with absolute integrity and use the best products on the roof. I was helped by Stetson who is really great in the work he does and was able to explain me the entire process of how the claim filing works and more importantly the details of the replacement roof shingles to be installed on my home.

He never upsold anything to me nor tried to loot me even for a penny. The best part I liked about IFC roofing is that, when they inspect the roof of

IFC redid our synthetic slate roof and gutters. We had a wonderful experience. Adam worked to get insurance to cover everything even though it was initially denied. Install went well and customer service was exceptional. Our homeowners insurance premiums were cut in half! The previous roof was 15 years old.

My experience with IFC Roofing was exceptional, especially with the project manager, Tyler Thomson. He walked me through the whole process, answering my questions and providing updates as the roof replacement process was ongoing. He also worked closely with my insurance company’s claims adjuster in the roof inspection, modifications to the claim, and documenting all the work done,.There was one small leak, but Tyler had his people quickly repair the leak, test the repair, and repair the damage i

I highly recommend IFC roofing. Th GC Mike Burch did an excellent job negotiating with our insurance company and managing the project. The roof and gutters look great. Thank you for the excellent service IFC and Mike.

IFC Roofing did an outstanding job with my roof. Stetson was the representative that I worked with. He was professional, knowledgeable, and didn’t try to upsell me. I contacted IFC Roofing based on the signs in my neighborhood (jobs in progress) and reviews. I wasn’t disappointed. The new roof looks great, there are no leaks, and my new radiant barrier is keeping the summer electric bills down.

It’s always good to be able to say great things about great people. Mike Burch from IFC Roofing made a difficult hail damage experience easy for our family and managed every aspect of the repair from start to finish with high levels of honesty and integrity. I highly recommend IFC and recommend you ask for Mike as the general contractor. He’s really good.

Working with IFC was seamless and stress-free. As many of us know, getting insurance companies to pay out these days can feel impossible — even after paying them thousands of dollars year after year. In our case, State Farm initially offered to cover only 25 shingles on our 17-year-old roof (hard to believe, right?).

I highly recommend Tim Flood and the IFC crew.  They did a great job and cleaned up afterwards.  Tim diligently strived throughout the process too make sure we received the new roof, gutters and repairs we asked for.  The IFC back office also were very professional and responsive.  Great job!!!

Mike Burch and his team did an outstanding job in replacing our roof and ancillary repairs resulting from the May 2024 storms.  Could not be more pleased with the process, the communications with IFC and the ultimate outcome.  Anyone needing a new roof will not go wrong selecting IFC.

Adam and the team at IFC are second to none! Great communication, and they PAY ON TIME!! As a subcontractor that means a lot to us to be valued and appreciated! Look forward to many projects in the future!

We were hit hard in a 2024 hail storm.  The only person I knew who did roofing was a guy (Dagen Bell) with IFC who tried to help me in 2021.  It seemed a long shot that Dagen still worked for them, but when I called he answered.  I respect that level of loyalty.  I gave Dagen/IFC the job to handle the roofing and the insurance details because I thought if I had any problems in 3 years (or whenever), Dagen would still be there to help me.
* anyways, the BEST customer service, knowledge, patience,

After hail storm, we used IFC Roofing to replace roof and all the small things damaged around the house. Stetson Clark was our main contact but the owner Will was also involved. They were honest people who do great work. They replaced the roof quickly and professionally. They used CertainTeed shingles which are top of the line. Installation was done in 1 day and a few small tasks the next day. This was a very large roof so getting it done in a day was amazing. They used their own crews not some

To make it worse, after the last rain we got tons of nails on our driveway from nails they left in the gutters, see picture. Got a nail in my tire from a roofing nail. Ok, so they didn't clean up... It gets worse. Roof is still leaking and in fact, leaking more. Company was made aware after 1st rain and said leak was coming from elsewhere. IFC Roofing's work was professional and excellent! Our project manager, Darlene Roth, led the way with exceptional service and responsiveness, gave great advice, and did a lot of important interfacing with the insurance company. Highly recommend!

Huge thanks to the IFC team for the rapid response and high quality workmanship after our roof and gutters were damaged by hail! Our rep was Guy Nickels and he did a fantastic job getting us turned around quickly.

Not only did they do a great job on a large roof and gutter replacement, years ago they were driving by and saw a damaged shingle on our roof ahead of a major storm. They stopped by, rang the bell, and fixed it at no charge. This customer service led us to call them when we needed maj

We met the IFC Team nine years ago when they replaced our roof.  They were great.  They handled meetings with the insurance company so that our best interest was represented.  The install went as they said it would.  We were very satisfied.
Now, nine years later, they are still providing outstanding service and helping to protect one of our most valuable assets.

We had an exceptional experience with Guy Nickels and the IFC team for our roof replacement and other repairs after the Memorial Day storm earlier this year. Guy led the charge and guided us through the entire process from beginning to end. Guy went above and beyond to take care of us and ensure that we were satisfied with every little detail of the project - from doing temporary repairs, to dealing with the insurance claim and the adjusters, to giving us advice, to replacing our roof and gutter

I recently had my roof and gutters replaced by IFC due to storm damage…David Taylor and Cathy Parada handled the operation in a very professional manner…From the initial inspection, to the actual roof and gutter replacement, to the final walk around ( punch list completion ) they paid excellent attention to detail and were also very attentive to my input…I gave them five stars and would recommend IFC if you have any roofing needs…

The Team at IFC roofing exceeded expectations with their meticulous roof replacement job. From start to finish they were professional. Their commitment to quality craftsmanship was evident and timely started and completed the project. We are throughly pleased with their work and highly recommend them for anyone considering roof and or gutter replacement.

We had a “difficulty” with our insurance company on a roof repair. IFC started a process to work with us and our insurance company that took about a year before we “won” our case. IFC stayed with us through the entire process and were able to make all necessary repairs plus some extras. Robert was instrumental at every stage of the process and has become a family friend! Thank you IFC!

We had to leave town when IFC replaced our roof and Robert keep us updated via calls and pictures. A couple of hiccups and he was on it. I appreciate that he was in charge, was the one who step up and step in and did some of the work himself.

Tex helped us with our new roof and recommended other contractors for projects and we were very happy with all.  The IFC guys did a great job and it was done quickly.  Tex is knowledgeable and helpful, worked well with our insurance company and made sure we were pleased with the work.  I highly recommend.

I would not recommend this company!  They did not communicate with me about the decision affecting the color of my gutters.  They spoke only to my husband who knows nothing about color contrast.  What a nightmare!  Not too mention the stress on my marriage.  I’m still trying to figure out why didn’t you just leave them there original color.  Hopefully they don’t continue with this type of behavior.  Lesson learned!!!

We had a great experience with IFC Roofing! They came recommended by a friend and we feel lucky to have found them. Adam came out to do our roof inspection.  He was prompt, communicative and professional. Adam explained the inspection process and we received a thorough inspection on the same day of his visit.  Highly Recommend IFC Roofing!

IFC installed a new roof on my home in Colleyville in April, 2022 as well as an all new gutter system with leaf guards. Then they  painted the entire exterior of our home. Their designer came out twice to help select the color to match our brick and she was a great help. Very knowledgable and customer oriented.
IFC helped we work through some issues with our insurance company and stuck with us and gave use great advice through out the process.
They started the job on time and completed the roof
The process went very smoothly with no issues with our insurance company. Mike explained how and what to expect.  I definitely would recommend IFC!

This is long overdue, but the quality of service and their focus on helping you first and foremost is unmatched.

Adam from IFC helped me more times than I can count with damage and leaks to the roof.

New leak pop as it’s raining? They’re there to help.

Need to ask some questions and get some guidance? They know it.

Finally get around to actually replacing your roof? They’ll get the toughest job done faster than you can believe without skipping a beat.

From the initial consultation to the final inspection, Darlene demonstrated professionalism, expertise, and a commitment to excellence that truly exceeded my expectations.

Cannot say enough about Will and the team and IFC.  Will is always timely in getting back to me and really helps me explore the correct roofing needs for my personalized situation.  Once we agreed on my solution is team was outstanding in the installation.  If I could, I would give IFC 10 stars.

The staffing at IFC, from the business office to the roofers to the general contractor, was terrific. They did a fantastic job working with the insurance on our total roof replacement. Having an experienced GP (Will) who knows and understands the intricacies of how insurance companies look at damage was extremely valuable. If we had gone without an experienced roofing company, our insurance would have only replaced 93 shingles. I am grateful for all the staff who work with integrity and represen

We had an amazing experience working with IFC roofing. Both Adam and Lauren were great to work with. We had a very strict timeline to get our roof done since we were selling our house and they went above and beyond to make sure everything was completed in time. They were great with dealing with the insurance company so we didn’t have to. The workers who came and completed our roof were incredible! We were moving and packing while they were working and they even helped us move some of our heavier

IFC roofing is awesome! They did a repair on my roof and it looks great! They matched the shingles perfectly and you can’t even tell where the work was done. Everyone was professional and friendly! Any future roofing needs, I will be calling them!

ICF roofing did a great job on our new roof as well as taking good care of my mother in law’s roof along with other things. We highly recommend them to anyone interested in installing a new roof. Very kind people to work with and top notch!

IFC just replaced our entire roof after hail damage/total loss and we couldn’t be more pleased. From start to finish the process was super smooth- starting with a rep meeting our insurance company at the inspection, making sure we understood the process and guiding us to pick out colors and products. The construction team was very professional, protected our property well, and we had a great point of contact through the process. They did an excellent job at clean up and put items back where they

Recently sold my house and needed a new roof on a tight time frame before closing.  Met with Guy from IFC and was throughly impressed with his knowledge, ability to clearly articulate the steps and insurance process and then his “hands on involvement” throughout the entire process. Knowing the tight schedule, IFC dedicated 3 crews to my house and completed the tear off and installation of 100 squares in one day.  Gutters were installed 2 days later……deadline easily achieved.  Quality work, great

This was my first time replacing my roof through my Homeowners Insurance, and Robert made it a super easy experience. He gave me a game-plan with all the details, set everything up for us, kept us updated throughout the whole process, and followed through with everything we agreed to. He even got some items approved for replacement, that our Insurance had previously denied.

Overall, it was a great, turnkey experience. I’ll definitely go to him next time we need any more work done on our home.

Had an insurance claim due to hail damage to get a new roof. I saw IFC's reviews online and decided to go with them and they were top of the line. They represented me dealing with insurance and I was able to get a new roof, gutters, drip edge, attic vents, vent stack covers, window screens, skylights, chimney shroud and fence, and the work was done within a month of the storm and looks great! Props to Brian, Tiffany, Amber and Sam for a job well done. I would definitely recommend them to anyone.

Tex went above and beyond in the handling of our damage claim and insurance adjusters. The service was exemplary and I would highly recommend IFC and will be using them again. Also had gutters installed and we couldn't be happier with the quality.
I would rate 10 stars if I could. Stellar Company!!

I can't say enough good things about this company.  They did the work quickly and efficiently and managed the entire process from start to finish.  Dagan Bell is the most professional and responsive customer representative I've ever dealt with.  I very highly recommend both IFC and Dagan.  Thanks Dagan and IFC.

Mike Burch is an exceptional project manager and is the man you want on your job!   He is honest, diligent about his work, detailed oriented and just a great person to get to know. I really enjoyed working with Mike to replace my aging roof and perform additional work on the exterior of my home. He was able to answer all of my questions, provided me samples and took care of all the details. I’m somewhat of a picky person but with IFC I have no complaints; the job was done right!  I would recomme

We worked with IFC Roofing on an inspection we needed done for our home.  We couldn't have been happier with their service.  Specifically we worked with Adam Ullrich.  He was informative, great with communication, very professional, and was able to help us with our situation in a timely manner.  I would highly recommend engaging this company for any issues you may have with your roof.

What a great experience!  Tim Flood came out and provided a comprehensive inspection of our roof.  Explained his findings in a clear and thorough manner...and charged us nothing for his trouble.  Tim's now in my speed dial.  Whenever a roofing need pops up I know who I'm going to call.  Thanks Tim!!

I am extremely pleased with IFC Roofing! Mitch Deskis was amazing to work with. He was very kind, responsive and knowledgeable. He helped me through the whole process and handled all communication with my insurance company. IFC did good quality work and delivered on time. 10/10 recommend!

We worked with Mitch Deskis for our new roof and gutter installation. There are no words to express how great this experience was for us. The professionalism was top notch. The installation crew was fantastic and Mitch saw this project through to the end. We have replaced a roof before but never did we think that it would be such a positive experience. Project managers Jesse and Bryan, the roofing supervisor Jose along with a cast of dozens of others from plumbers, tilers, office support and painters to gutter installers and chimney experts, all were a pleasure to work with. IFC Roofing has extremely trained personnel from the heads of the company to the clean up crew. Our personal project manager,  Adam Sadler, was with us every step of the way. He answered every question, anticipated and supervised with a caring attitude.  I give them a 10 not a 5.

Adam and his team did a superb job for us. He did a thorough and highly competent roof inspection and coordinated with our homeowners insurance carrier facilitating a warranted full roof replacement under our policy. We were not aware of the roof damage as we were traveling at the time of the storm. Adam and his team were very easy to contract with, delivered fully in all their commitments, complied with all our HOA requirements and delivered on time and on budget. I highly recommend Adam and IF

IFC roofing helped us get our roof done efficiently and quickly. They worked with our insurance and we were able to get the work approved. We have been trying for several years and they came through for us, Thank You! They communicated with us very well throughout the work and dealing with them [especially Tex F] was great. They also worked on the gutters, chimney and window screens. They are a "Top Notch" company, very professional and friendly. We are very satisfied customers!

We had a great experience working with IFC. They were so helpful dealing with our insurance company and really fought for us when our adjuster claimed we had a different type of roof than we actually had. They also came back out at 7 am when a storm damaged our roof a few months after installation. Altogether very helpful, quick and reliable. I would highly recommend.
